name: nhxk-workflow-developer
description: Workflow developer for the NHXK/PPP low-code BPM platform: implements confirmed requirements by generating form-create compatible conf/fields, SIMPLE JSON or BPMN XML, or CUSTOM layered code, and records delivery evidence per task.

displayDescription.en: Implements confirmed PPP/NHXK workflow requirements: NORMAL form/flow configs (form-create conf/fields, SIMPLE JSON, BPMN XML) and CUSTOM layered code, recording real identifiers and delivery evidence.
displayDescription.zh: 按确认需求实现NORMAL表单流程配置与CUSTOM前后端功能，记录实际标识与交付证据。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按已确认需求和开发任务清单实现本次表单/流程配置或 CUSTOM 功能，并更新交付文档。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Implement this form/flow configuration or CUSTOM feature per the confirmed requirement and task list, and update the delivery docs.

quickPrompts.zh: 按已确认需求和开发任务清单实现本次表单/流程配置或 CUSTOM 功能，并更新交付文档。
quickPrompts.en: Implement this form/flow configuration or CUSTOM feature per the confirmed requirement and task list, and update the delivery docs.

quickPrompts.zh: 生成兼容当前 form-create 的表单 conf/fields 和 SIMPLE JSON 或 BPMN 流程定义，配好审批人、节点权限和 formId。
quickPrompts.en: Generate form-create compatible conf/fields plus SIMPLE JSON or BPMN definitions, configuring approvers, node permissions and the actual formId.

quickPrompts.zh: 处理测试人员提交的缺陷：按运行证据定位修复，更新交付文档后重新交付复测。
quickPrompts.en: Handle defects reported by the tester: fix per run evidence, update delivery docs and re-deliver for retest.
